Message.Name: Sequence Number Reset Message
Message.Description: This message is sent to reset the Message Sequence Number at start of day, or in response to failures.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID for this NYSE feed listed in the feed’s client specification.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel over which the packet was sent.

Message.Name: Source Time Reference Message
Message.Description: This message is sent at the start of every second during periods of active data publication.

Field.Name: Id
Field.Description: ID of the originating Matching Engine partition to which this message applies.

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. Ignore any content. This usage will become standard across all products in future releases.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Message.Name: Symbol Index Mapping Message
Message.Description: This message is published over the real-time data channels at system startup or in the context of a refresh sequence after a Matching Engine or XDP Publisher failover. It provides referential data for a single specified symbol.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this symbol for all products within this market. This ID cannot be used to cross reference a security between markets.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Null-terminated ASCII symbol in NYSE Symbology.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: This field is reserved for future use

Field.Name: Market ID
Field.Description: ID of the Originating Market

Field.Name: System ID
Field.Description: ID of the Originating matching engine server.

Field.Name: Exchange Code
Field.Description: For listed equity markets, the market where this symbol is listed

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Specifies placement of the decimal point in price fields for this security.

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: Type of Security used by Arca, National and American

Field.Name: Lot Size
Field.Description: Round lot size in shares.

Field.Name: PrevClosePrice
Field.Description: The previous day’s closing price for this security.

Field.Name: PrevCloseVolume
Field.Description: The previous day’s closing volume for the security.

Field.Name: Price Resolution
Field.Description: All Penny, Penny/Nickel, Nickel/Dime

Field.Name: Round Lot
Field.Description: Round Lots Accepted

Field.Name: MPV
Field.Description: The minimum increment for a trade price, in 100ths of a cent. Typically 1, or $0.0001, but for some Tick Pilot stocks, can be 500, or $0.05.

Field.Name: Unit of Trade
Field.Description: This field specifies the security Unit of Trade in shares. Valid values are 1, 10, 50 and 100

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. Disregard any content.

Message.Name: Retransmission Request Message
Message.Description: Clients who have experienced a sequence number gap and need a retransmission of the missed messages should send a Retransmission Request message via TCP to the Request Controller. A Request Response message will be sent over the TCP connection back to the client, and if the request was valid, the requested message(s) will be re-published over the relevant Retransmission multicast channel.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: The beginning sequence number of the range of messages to be retransmitted.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: The end sequence number of the range of messages to be retransmitted.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client requesting this retransmission . This field is up to 9 characters, null terminated.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which a retransmission is requested (listed in the feed’s client specification).

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel on which the gap occurred.

Message.Name: Request Response Message
Message.Description: This message will be sent immediately via TCP/IP in response to the client’s request for retransmission, refresh or Symbol Mapping messages.

Field.Name: RequestSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of the request message sent by the client.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: For Retrans Request responses, the beginning sequence number of the requested retransmission range.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: For Retrans Request responses, the ending sequence number of the requested retransmission range.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client making the request. This field is up to 9 characters, null terminated.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which the request was made (listed in the feed’s client specification).

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel for which the request was made.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: The reason why the request was rejected.

Message.Name: Heartbeat Response Message
Message.Description: Clients who remain connected to the Retransmission Server intraday must respond to a Heartbeat with a Heartbeat Response message within 5 seconds. If no timely client response is received, the connection will be closed.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the connected client. This field is up to 9 characters, null terminated.

Message.Name: Symbol Index Mapping Request Message
Message.Description: This message is sent by clients via TCP/IP requesting the Symbol Index Mapping messages for one or all symbols in a specified channel.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID (from the Symbol Index msg) of the symbol for which a refresh is requested.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client requesting this symbol refresh. This field is up to 9 characters, null terminated.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which the refresh is requested (listed in the feed’s client specification).

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel for which the refresh is requested.

Field.Name: RetransmitMethod
Field.Description: The delivery method for the requested symbol index mapping information.

Message.Name: Refresh Request Message
Message.Description: Clients who have experienced a failure and need a refresh of the state of one or all symbols in a specific channel should send a Retransmission Request message via TCP to the Request Controller. A Request Response message will be sent over the TCP connection back to the client, and if the request was valid, the requested message(s) will be published over the relevant Refresh multicast channel.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID (from the Symbol Index msg) of the symbol for which a refresh is requested. To request a refresh for all symbols in the channel, set this field to 0.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client requesting this refresh. This field is up to 9 characters, null terminated.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which the refresh is requested (listed in the feed’s client specification).

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel for which the refresh is requested.

Message.Name: Message Unavailable Message
Message.Description: This message will be sent over the Retransmission multicast channels to inform clients of unavailability of a range of messages (or part of a range) for which they may have requested a retransmission.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: The beginning sequence number of the unavailable range of messages.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: The ending sequence number of the unavailable range of messages.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which the retransmission was requested (listed in the feed’s client specification).

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel for which the retransmission was requested.

Message.Name: Symbol Clear Message
Message.Description: In case of a failure and recovery of a Matching Engine or an XDP Publisher, the publisher may send a full state refresh for every symbol affected. This kind of unrequested refresh is preceded by a Symbol Clear message. The client should react to receipt of a Symbol Clear message by clearing all state information for the specified symbol in anticipation of receiving a full state refresh.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: NextSourceSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number in the next message for this symbol

Message.Name: Security Status Message
Message.Description: This message informs clients of changes in the status of a specific security, such as Trading Halts, Short Sale Restriction state changes, etc.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The unique ID of this message in the sequence of messages published for this specific symbol.

Field.Name: Security Status
Field.Description: The new status that this security is transitioning to.

Field.Name: Halt Condition
Field.Description: Halt condition indicator

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Future use. Any field content should be ignored.

Field.Name: Price 1
Field.Description: Default value is 0

Field.Name: Price 2
Field.Description: Default value is 0

Field.Name: SSR Triggering Exchange ID
Field.Description: This field is only populated when securityStatus = A and this security is listed on this exchange. Otherwise it is defaulted to 0x20.

Field.Name: SSR Triggering Volume
Field.Description: This field is only populated when securityStatus = A and this security is listed on this exchange

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Format : HHMMSSmmm (mmm = milliseconds)

Field.Name: SSRState
Field.Description: The current SSR state, which this msg updates if the Security Status field contains an SSR Code. Valid

Field.Name: MarketState
Field.Description: The current Market State, which this msg updates if the Security Status field contains a Market State Code.

Field.Name: SessionState
Field.Description: Unused. Defaulted to 0x00.

Message.Name: Refresh Header Message
Message.Description: The first message in each packet of refresh messages published over the Refresh multicast channels is of this type.

Field.Name: CurrentRefreshPkt
Field.Description: The current refresh packet in the update

Field.Name: TotalRefreshPkts
Field.Description: The total number of refresh packets you should expect in the update

Field.Name: LastSeqNum
Field.Description: The last sequence number sent on the channel for any symbol. The refresh is the state of the order book as of this sequence number.

Field.Name: LastSymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The last symbol sequence number sent for this symbol. The refresh is the symbol state of this symbol as of this symbol sequence number.

Message.Name: Quote Message
Message.Description: A quote message is sent when any event results in a new top of book value on either side of the market.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index message.

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The symbol sequence number.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: The Ask price. Use the Price scale from the Symbol Index message.

Field.Name: Ask Volume
Field.Description: The aggregate round lot size at the ask price, in shares.

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: The Bid price. Use the Price scale from the Symbol Index message.

Field.Name: Bid Volume
Field.Description: The aggregate round lot size at the bid price, in shares.

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: Quote condition values. For markets other than NYSE, only condition R is applicable.

Field.Name: RPI Indicator
Field.Description: The side(s) where Retail Price Indication orders (RPI orders) exist.

Value.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt Level 1
Value.Description: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt Level 1

Value.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt Level 2
Value.Description: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt Level 2

Value.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt Level 3
Value.Description: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt Level 3

Enum.Name: Security Status
Enum.Description: The new status that this security is transitioning to

Value.Name: No open/no resume
Value.Description: No open/no resume (NYSE tape A only)

Enum.Name: RetransmitMethod
Enum.Description: The delivery method for the requested symbol index mapping information.

Enum.Name: Exchange Code
Enum.Description: For listed equity markets, the market where this symbol is listed

Enum.Name: Security Type
Enum.Description: Type of Security used by Arca, National and American

Value.Name: Retail Interest on the Bid and Offer side
